environment.description: NestJS telemetry microservice running on ECS Fargate in a private subnet. The task role has s3:PutObject permission on prod-telemetry-raw/*. The service is exposed via an internal ALB with no request body inspection. Node.js 18 runtime with default V8 heap settings. The /ingest endpoint accepts raw binary POST bodies up to 1MB. No network-level payload inspection between the ALB and the container.

config.s3_endpoint: default regional endpoint via NAT gateway
